question.text: A series <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>L</mi><mi>C</mi><mi>R</mi></math> circuit with <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtext>100 </mtext><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi></math> resistance is connected to an ac source of <math> <mrow> <mtext>200 V</mtext></mrow> </math> with an angular frequency of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mtext>300 rad s</mtext><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>. If only the capacitor is removed, the current lags behind the voltage by a phase of <math> <mrow> <msup> <mrow> <mtext>60</mtext></mrow> <mo>∘</mo></msup></mrow></math>. If only the inductor is removed, the current leads the voltage by a phase of <math> <mrow> <msup> <mrow> <mtext>60</mtext></mrow> <mo>∘</mo></msup></mrow></math>. The current and the power dissipated in the circuit is

solution.text:
From given condition circuit is at resonance

For LR circuit,

tan60= X L R           ⇒ X L = 3 R

For CR circuit

tan60= X C R ⇒ X C = 3 R        ⇒ X L = X C = 3 R

I rms = V rms R = 200 100 = 2 Amp

P = I 2 R = 4 × 100 = 400 Watt
